einzeiler: Tara Shannon on pursuing passions, redefining success, and stopping the wait for…
kurzfassung: Tara Shannon discusses her return to music, the importance of pursuing personal passions without waiting for outside approval, and why traditional ideas of the music industry are flawed. She explains how her coaching philosophy centers on self-understanding and looking inward for validation rather than chasing external metrics of success. Ultimately, she emphasizes that true fulfillment comes from aligning one's life with personal vision rather than societal expectations.
stichpunkte: Music is an essential, woven part of Tara Shannon's identity, leading her to return to the path and start her own label.
Ignoring a deep-seated passion can create a profound lack of fulfillment and leave a person feeling incomplete.
Society often promotes a disempowering Cinderella story about being discovered by someone in power rather than creating one's own success.
True success requires redefining personal vision and stopping the wait for permission from others to live the life you want.
Business is fundamentally about people, and understanding others starts with understanding oneself.
Effective coaching focuses on identifying patterns of seeking outside validation and learning to look inward instead.
Society's definition of success based on money and material goods is temporary and ultimately unfulfilling.

beschreibung:
What happens when you build a successful life but abandon the one thing that makes you feel whole?
Tara Shannon did everything right. Thirty years in music and business, a thriving career, a beautiful family. But somewhere along the way she stepped away from music — and a life-changing health scare brought her back.
In this episode of Music Explored Podcast, Anthony Lewis sits down with Tara Shannon — Canadian singer-songwriter, record label founder, music coach, author of You and the Music Business, and Executive Director of the Ottawa Festival Network — for a conversation about what it really means to build a life in music on your own terms.
This is not a conversation about getting discovered. It's about stopping the wait for someone else to give you permission to live the life you want. Tara's coaching philosophy starts with one principle — to succeed in the business of music, you first have to succeed in the business of you.
They cover the Cinderella myth the music industry keeps selling, why looking for external validation keeps musicians stuck, how mindset is at the core of every successful artist she's coached, and what it means to redefine success on your own terms.
Whether you're a working musician, an independent creator, or someone who put their passion on the back burner — this one will stay with you.
